text:
Maria (AE): quick sync on BridgeBank pilot — they want a 6-week POC for 'smart-reconciliation' features. Main asks: 1) success criteria for accuracy + latency, 2) runbook for security questionnaire (SOC2 + data residency), 3) pricing for dedicated pilot, 4) eval harness plan (golden prompts, scoring, regression gates). can folks chime in?

Ali (SE): I can lead the eval harness. proposed high-level: - golden dataset: 350 positive examples, 150 edge-case negatives from their ledger dumps (sanitized) - metrics: exact-match / normalized-fscore for structured extraction, embedding-similarity (cosine) for fuzzy match, latency p95 <= 180ms on hosted, <= 80ms on Dedicated target - regression gates: blocked if EM drops > 3% absolute or cosine mean drops > 0.04 vs baseline - baseline model: open-llama-13b-quant (we'll run both 13B quant and 7B float for comparison)

Maria (AE): that sounds reasonable. pricing note: BridgeBank expects a committed-month estimate for Dedicated during the pilot; can we produce a ballpark for a 4-GPU pool?

Jordan (Eng): for a 4-GPU dedicated pool (A100-ish), rough ballpark = $Xk/mo (we'll provide formal quote). technical note: to hit <=80ms p95 we need batching disabled for tail requests or tiny batch windows + KV cache warmup. also we should size for peak concurrency expected (they mentioned 120 qps burst).

Grace (Security): on questionnaires: ask BridgeBank to use our standard security intake doc. immediate blockers: 1) data residency — they want EU-only processing, we can do that in eu-west region private deployment, 2) encryption at rest with customer-managed keys (KMS) — needs paperwork & integration lead time (~2 weeks), 3) SOC2 evidence — we can provide.

Ali (SE): on harness infra — plan to run evals in CI with these artifacts: - prompts/labels in CSV: id, prompt, expected_json, category, sensitivity_flag - scoring config (example YAML below) - regression job that compares new model vs golden baseline and fails if gates tripped

Ali (SE): ```
scoring:
  tasks:
    - name: extract-payee
      metric: normalized_f1
      threshold: 0.97
    - name: fuzzy-match
      metric: mean_cosine
      threshold: 0.88
regression:
  allow_failure: false
  gates:
    em_drop_abs: 0.03
    cosine_drop: 0.04
```

Maria (AE): nice. timeline check: week0 ingest and sanitize sample data, week1-2 build harness + baseline runs, week3-4 candidate model tuning, week5 integration tests + security signoff, week6 demo + acceptance. all okay?

Jordan (Eng): timeline looks tight but doable if we get the sample data by Monday. also need confirmation if they want streaming responses vs full-response — that affects latency expectations.

Grace (Security): KMS onboarding and paperwork clock starts when we have their security contact + org details. i'll draft the email template.

Ali (SE): action items: 1) Maria to get sanitized sample by Mon (or tell us constraints) 2) Grace to send KMS onboarding checklist 3) Jordan to size Dedicated quote and validate p95 targets 4) I'll start scaffolding the harness repo and add the scoring YAML.

Maria (AE): agreed, i'll ping their security lead today and loop in bridgebank-data@. sending sample deadline now. thanks team :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI pipeline created: sales/bridgebank/poc-harness — initial scaffold pushed (CI run queued).

Ali (SE): thanks — i'll watch the CI and attach the golden CSV once we have sanitized data.

Jordan (Eng): FYI if we need to test on-private (air-gapped) we'll need extra lead time for infra deployment (~3 weeks). calling that out now.

Maria (AE): noted. will confirm whether they need private or EU-hosted only. back later with updates.

Grace (Security): also flagged contractual clause: customer can't force model access to third-party training; asking legal to prepare a POC addendum.

Ali (SE): perfect. let's keep thread for status updates.

Maria (AE): closing loop — moving to next steps, will post sample when available.
